preview_heading: Kingsmen meet Knight Riders in Kingston
preview: Jamaica Kingsmen face Trinbago Knight Riders in CPL 2026 Match 8 at Sabina Park. The match is scheduled for Sat 15 Aug at 7pm local time.
preview_detail: The CPL's newest franchise restores a Jamaica-based men's team, led by a local group featuring Rovman Powell, Andre Russell and Odean Smith. The 2025 champions retain a decorated core led by Sunil Narine, Nicholas Pooran, Kieron Pollard and Akeal Hosein as they pursue another title. The final playing XIs will be confirmed after the toss.
